panels.title: Intraday trading PnL by book, USD, with drawdown
panels.description: Today's trading PnL per book on the panel interval (10 s and up) to the right edge of the time range: running position and cash from positions_running_day, the mark of each bucket from the 10-second bars of the primary listing (quotes_10s), USD from usd_factor_asof; and the drawdown of the selected books' total over the range. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @asof := '${__to:date:iso}',
        @day  := timestamp_floor('d', '${__to:date:iso}'::timestamp)
WITH grid AS (
  SELECT ts, book, symbol, last(pos) AS pos, last(cost) AS cost
  FROM ${prefix}positions_running_day
  WHERE ts <= @asof AND book IN (${book:singlequote})
  SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval FILL(PREV)
),
mk AS (
  SELECT ts, symbol, last(close) AS mark
  FROM ${prefix}quotes_10s
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= @asof
    AND symbol IN (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM ${prefix}fills
                   WHERE ts >= @day AND ts <= @asof AND book IN (${book:singlequote}))
  SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval FILL(PREV)
),
pnl AS (
  SELECT g.ts, g.book, sum((g.pos * coalesce(m.mark, ml.price) - g.cost) * u.factor) AS pnl_usd
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN mk m ON (ts, symbol)
  JOIN ${prefix}marks_live ml ON (symbol)
  JOIN ${prefix}usd_factor_asof u ON (symbol)
  GROUP BY g.ts, g.book
),
r AS (
  SELECT ts, book, pnl_usd FROM pnl WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
),
tot AS (
  SELECT ts, sum(pnl_usd) AS total FROM r GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
),
dd AS (
  SELECT ts, total - max(total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS drawdown FROM tot
)
SELECT ts, book, pnl_usd FROM r
UNION ALL
SELECT ts, 'Drawdown, selected books' AS book, drawdown AS pnl_usd FROM dd
ORDER BY ts, book

panels.title: Front months, live
panels.description: The front month of every curve on its primary listing: the latest quote in the ten minutes up to the right edge of the range, the change since the last settlement in the price unit and in percent, and the seconds since that quote. Primary listings only, so the planted EEX feed outage does not show here: the primary keeps ticking.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @asof := '${__to:date:iso}',
        @day  := timestamp_floor('d', '${__to:date:iso}'::timestamp)
WITH f AS (
  SELECT symbol, exchange_symbol, curve FROM ${prefix}tenors_asof WHERE tenor IN ('M1', 'Z1')
),
q AS (
  SELECT symbol, source, bid, ask, ts FROM ${prefix}quotes
  WHERE ts <= @asof AND ts > dateadd('m', -10, @asof::timestamp)
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol, source
),
p AS (
  SELECT q.symbol, q.bid, q.ask, q.ts
  FROM q JOIN ${prefix}listings l ON l.symbol = q.symbol AND l.exchange = q.source AND l.is_primary
),
st AS (
  SELECT symbol, price FROM ${prefix}settlements
  WHERE ts < @day AND ts >= dateadd('d', -7, @day)
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol
)
SELECT f.symbol, f.exchange_symbol, p.bid, p.ask, mid(p.bid, p.ask) AS mid,
       mid(p.bid, p.ask) - st.price                    AS change,
       100 * (mid(p.bid, p.ask) - st.price) / st.price AS change_pct,
       datediff('T', p.ts::timestamp, @asof::timestamp) / 1000.0 AS age_s
FROM f
JOIN p ON (symbol)
LEFT JOIN st ON (symbol)
ORDER BY f.curve

panels.title: PnL and position blotter, as of the end of the range
panels.description: Per book and contract: net position, the live mark at the right edge of the range (the latest primary-listing mid from marks_live, or the curve builder's mark where there is no fresh quote), the opening book revalued from settlement, today's trading and the total, in USD. Reads ledger, marks_live and usd_factor_asof. 1a_pnl_by_book values the same book at the official minute marks (marks_asof).

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @asof := '${__to:date:iso}',
        @day  := timestamp_floor('d', '${__to:date:iso}'::timestamp)
SELECT l.book, l.symbol, li.exchange_symbol,
       sum(l.qty)                                                                          AS position,
       last(m.price)                                                                       AS mark,
       sum(CASE WHEN l.src = 'sod'   THEN l.qty * (m.price - l.px) * u.factor ELSE 0 END) AS sod_revalued_usd,
       sum(CASE WHEN l.src = 'trade' THEN l.qty * (m.price - l.px) * u.factor ELSE 0 END) AS todays_trading_usd,
       sum(l.qty * (m.price - l.px) * u.factor)                                            AS total_pnl_usd
FROM ${prefix}ledger l
JOIN ${prefix}marks_live m ON (symbol)
JOIN ${prefix}usd_factor_asof u ON (symbol)
JOIN (SELECT symbol, exchange_symbol FROM ${prefix}listings WHERE is_primary) li ON (symbol)
WHERE l.ts >= @day AND l.ts <= @asof AND l.book IN (${book:singlequote})
GROUP BY l.book, l.symbol, li.exchange_symbol
ORDER BY l.book, l.symbol

panels.title: Limit utilisation, now and intraday peak
panels.description: Net position per book and curve against its limit: now (the right edge of the range) and the intraday peak, from the opening snapshot plus every fill since 00:00. The CRUDE / BRENT breach sits at the top. Same numbers as 2a_limits_now_vs_peak.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @asof := '${__to:date:iso}',
        @day  := timestamp_floor('d', '${__to:date:iso}'::timestamp)
WITH sod AS (
  SELECT book, curve, sum(qty) AS qty FROM ${prefix}position_snapshots
  WHERE ts = @day AND book IN (${book:singlequote})
  GROUP BY book, curve
),
traded AS (
  SELECT ts, book, curve, sum(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY book, curve ORDER BY ts) AS traded
  FROM ${prefix}fills
  WHERE ts >= @day AND ts <= @asof AND book IN (${book:singlequote})
),
running AS (
  SELECT @day AS ts, book, curve, qty AS net_qty FROM sod
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.ts, t.book, t.curve, coalesce(s.qty, 0) + t.traded AS net_qty
  FROM traded t LEFT JOIN sod s ON (book, curve)
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT * FROM running ORDER BY ts
),
lim AS (
  SELECT book, curve, max_abs_qty FROM ${prefix}limits
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY book, curve
)
SELECT r.book, r.curve,
       100 * abs(last(r.net_qty)) / l.max_abs_qty AS pct_now,
       100 * max(abs(r.net_qty)) / l.max_abs_qty  AS pct_peak
FROM ordered r
JOIN lim l ON (book, curve)
GROUP BY r.book, r.curve, l.max_abs_qty
ORDER BY pct_peak DESC

panels.title: Curve evolution, ${curve}: change since the start of the range, %
panels.description: Every tenor of the selected curve, front to back (months, then quarters, seasons and cals), on the panel interval (10 s and up): the last primary-listing mid of each bucket (quotes_10s) against the curve builder's mark at the start of the range, in percent. Grey is within 0.25% (0.125% for oil curves); the settlement comparison is the panel to the right.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @asof := '${__to:date:iso}', @from := '${__from:date:iso}'
WITH g AS (
  SELECT symbol, tenor, tenor_n,
         CASE WHEN granularity IN ('M', 'Z') THEN 1 WHEN granularity = 'Q' THEN 2
              WHEN granularity = 'S' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS g_order
  FROM ${prefix}tenors_asof
  WHERE curve = '${curve}'
    AND ((granularity IN ('M', 'Z') AND tenor_n <= 24) OR (granularity = 'Q' AND tenor_n <= 8)
         OR (granularity = 'S' AND tenor_n <= 4) OR (granularity = 'Y' AND tenor_n <= 3))
),
t AS (
  SELECT symbol, tenor, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY g_order, tenor_n) AS rk FROM g
),
base AS (
  SELECT symbol, price FROM ${prefix}curve_marks
  WHERE curve = '${curve}' AND ts <= @from AND ts > dateadd('d', -1, @from::timestamp)
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol
),
mk AS (
  SELECT ts, symbol, last(close) AS price
  FROM ${prefix}quotes_10s
  WHERE curve = '${curve}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= @asof
  SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval FILL(PREV)
)
SELECT mk.ts, lpad(t.rk::string, 2, '0') || ' ' || t.tenor AS tenor,
       100 * (coalesce(mk.price, b.price) - b.price) / b.price AS change_pct
FROM mk
JOIN t ON (symbol)
JOIN base b ON (symbol)
WHERE '${curve}' NOT IN ('BRENT', 'WTI', 'GASOIL')
ORDER BY mk.ts, t.rk

DECLARE @asof := '${__to:date:iso}', @from := '${__from:date:iso}'
WITH g AS (
  SELECT symbol, tenor, tenor_n,
         CASE WHEN granularity IN ('M', 'Z') THEN 1 WHEN granularity = 'Q' THEN 2
              WHEN granularity = 'S' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS g_order
  FROM ${prefix}tenors_asof
  WHERE curve = '${curve}'
    AND ((granularity IN ('M', 'Z') AND tenor_n <= 24) OR (granularity = 'Q' AND tenor_n <= 8)
         OR (granularity = 'S' AND tenor_n <= 4) OR (granularity = 'Y' AND tenor_n <= 3))
),
t AS (
  SELECT symbol, tenor, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY g_order, tenor_n) AS rk FROM g
),
base AS (
  SELECT symbol, price FROM ${prefix}curve_marks
  WHERE curve = '${curve}' AND ts <= @from AND ts > dateadd('d', -1, @from::timestamp)
  LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol
),
mk AS (
  SELECT ts, symbol, last(close) AS price
  FROM ${prefix}quotes_10s
  WHERE curve = '${curve}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= @asof
  SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval FILL(PREV)
)
SELECT mk.ts, lpad(t.rk::string, 2, '0') || ' ' || t.tenor AS tenor,
       100 * (coalesce(mk.price, b.price) - b.price) / b.price AS change_pct
FROM mk
JOIN t ON (symbol)
JOIN base b ON (symbol)
WHERE '${curve}' IN ('BRENT', 'WTI', 'GASOIL')
ORDER BY mk.ts, t.rk

panels.title: Live curve versus last settlement, ${curve} (${curve_unit})
panels.description: The month curve by delivery month: the live mark at the right edge of the range (marks_live: the latest primary-listing mid, or the curve builder's mark where there is no fresh quote) and the last official settlement before that day. The X axis is the delivery calendar.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @asof := '${__to:date:iso}',
        @day  := timestamp_floor('d', '${__to:date:iso}'::timestamp)
SELECT t.delivery_start::long / 1000 AS delivery, t.tenor,
       m.price AS mark_asof, s.price AS last_settlement
FROM ${prefix}marks_live m
JOIN ${prefix}tenors_asof t ON (symbol)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT symbol, price FROM ${prefix}settlements
           WHERE curve = '${curve}' AND ts < @day AND ts >= dateadd('d', -7, @day)
           LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol) s ON (symbol)
WHERE m.curve = '${curve}' AND t.granularity IN ('M', 'Z')
ORDER BY t.delivery_start

panels.title: Book as known versus as restated, USD
panels.description: The value of the day's deals at the marks of the range end: as the booking log showed it at each minute (as known: book_asof at that instant), and with every deal at its final version as known at the range end (as restated). The gap is purely bookings; the lines meet at the right edge and part at each late booking, amendment and cancel.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @asof := '${__to:date:iso}',
        @day  := timestamp_floor('d', '${__to:date:iso}'::timestamp)
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.booked_ts, e.trade_ts, e.trade_id, e.version,
         CASE WHEN e.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 0.0
              ELSE e.qty * (m.price - e.px) * u.factor END AS value_usd
  FROM ${prefix}trade_events e
  JOIN ${prefix}marks_asof m ON (symbol)
  JOIN ${prefix}usd_factor_asof u ON (symbol)
  WHERE e.booked_ts >= @day AND e.booked_ts <= @asof
    AND e.trade_ts >= @day AND e.trade_ts <= @asof
    AND e.book IN (${book:singlequote})
),
steps AS (
  SELECT booked_ts AS ts,
         value_usd - coalesce(lag(value_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY trade_id ORDER BY booked_ts, version), 0.0) AS delta
  FROM ev
  UNION ALL SELECT @day AS ts, 0.0 AS delta FROM long_sequence(1)
  UNION ALL SELECT @asof::timestamp AS ts, 0.0 AS delta FROM long_sequence(1)
),
known AS (
  SELECT ts, sum(delta) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS v FROM steps ORDER BY ts
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT ts, last(v) AS "Book as known"
  FROM (known TIMESTAMP(ts))
  SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(PREV)
) WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

DECLARE @asof := '${__to:date:iso}',
        @day  := timestamp_floor('d', '${__to:date:iso}'::timestamp)
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.booked_ts, e.trade_ts, e.trade_id, e.version,
         CASE WHEN e.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 0.0
              ELSE e.qty * (m.price - e.px) * u.factor END AS value_usd
  FROM ${prefix}trade_events e
  JOIN ${prefix}marks_asof m ON (symbol)
  JOIN ${prefix}usd_factor_asof u ON (symbol)
  WHERE e.booked_ts >= @day AND e.booked_ts <= @asof
    AND e.trade_ts >= @day AND e.trade_ts <= @asof
    AND e.book IN (${book:singlequote})
),
fin AS (
  SELECT trade_ts AS ts, value_usd FROM (
    SELECT trade_ts, value_usd,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY trade_id ORDER BY booked_ts DESC, version DESC) AS rn
    FROM ev)
  WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL SELECT @day AS ts, 0.0 AS value_usd FROM long_sequence(1)
  UNION ALL SELECT @asof::timestamp AS ts, 0.0 AS value_usd FROM long_sequence(1)
),
restated AS (
  SELECT ts, sum(value_usd) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS v FROM fin ORDER BY ts
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT ts, last(v) AS "Book as restated"
  FROM (restated TIMESTAMP(ts))
  SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(PREV)
) WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: PnL explain across the time range, USD
panels.description: Why the value of the day's deals changed across the range: market move on the opening positions, new trades, late bookings, amendments and cancellations. The five add up to the total. Same decomposition as 6c_pnl_forensics_t1_to_t2 with @t1 and @t2 at the range edges.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @t1 := '${__from:date:iso}', @t2 := '${__to:date:iso}'
WITH b1 AS (
  (SELECT * FROM ${prefix}trade_events
   WHERE booked_ts >= timestamp_floor('d', @t1::timestamp) AND booked_ts <= @t1
   LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
  WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts >= timestamp_floor('d', @t1::timestamp) AND trade_ts <= @t1
    AND book IN (${book:singlequote})
),
b2 AS (
  (SELECT * FROM ${prefix}trade_events
   WHERE booked_ts >= timestamp_floor('d', @t1::timestamp) AND booked_ts <= @t2
   LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
  WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND trade_ts >= timestamp_floor('d', @t1::timestamp) AND trade_ts <= @t2
    AND book IN (${book:singlequote})
),
both AS (
  SELECT coalesce(b1.symbol, b2.symbol) AS symbol,
         b1.qty AS q1, b1.px AS p1, b2.qty AS q2, b2.px AS p2, b2.trade_ts AS ts2
  FROM b1 FULL JOIN b2 ON b1.trade_id = b2.trade_id
),
m1 AS (SELECT symbol, price FROM ${prefix}curve_marks WHERE ts <= @t1 AND ts > dateadd('m', -5, @t1) LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol),
m2 AS (SELECT symbol, price FROM ${prefix}curve_marks WHERE ts <= @t2 AND ts > dateadd('m', -5, @t2) LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol),
f1 AS (SELECT symbol, mid(bid, ask) AS usd FROM ${prefix}quotes
       WHERE symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'EURGBP') AND ts <= @t1 AND ts > dateadd('h', -1, @t1) LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol),
f2 AS (SELECT symbol, mid(bid, ask) AS usd FROM ${prefix}quotes
       WHERE symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'GBPUSD', 'EURGBP') AND ts <= @t2 AND ts > dateadd('h', -1, @t2) LATEST ON ts PARTITION BY symbol),
x AS (
  SELECT t.q1, t.p1, t.q2, t.p2, t.ts2, a.price AS m1, b.price AS m2,
         c.px_factor * coalesce(u1.usd, 1.0) AS k1, c.px_factor * coalesce(u2.usd, 1.0) AS k2
  FROM both t
  JOIN m1 a ON a.symbol = t.symbol
  JOIN m2 b ON b.symbol = t.symbol
  JOIN ${prefix}instruments c ON c.symbol = t.symbol
  LEFT JOIN f1 u1 ON u1.symbol = c.fx_symbol
  LEFT JOIN f2 u2 ON u2.symbol = c.fx_symbol
),
s AS (
  SELECT sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NOT NULL THEN q1 * ((m2 - p1) * k2 - (m1 - p1) * k1) ELSE 0 END)                       AS market_move,
         sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NULL AND ts2 > @t1 THEN q2 * (m2 - p2) * k2 ELSE 0 END)                              AS new_trades,
         sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NULL AND ts2 <= @t1 THEN q2 * (m2 - p2) * k2 ELSE 0 END)                             AS late_bookings,
         sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NOT NULL AND q2 IS NOT NULL THEN (q2 * (m2 - p2) - q1 * (m2 - p1)) * k2 ELSE 0 END)  AS amendments,
         sum(CASE WHEN q2 IS NULL THEN -q1 * (m2 - p1) * k2 ELSE 0 END)                                           AS cancellations,
         sum(CASE WHEN q2 IS NOT NULL THEN q2 * (m2 - p2) * k2 ELSE 0 END)
           - sum(CASE WHEN q1 IS NOT NULL THEN q1 * (m1 - p1) * k1 ELSE 0 END)                                    AS total
  FROM x
)
SELECT 'Market move' AS component, market_move AS usd FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'New trades', new_trades FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Late bookings', late_bookings FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Amendments', amendments FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Cancellations', cancellations FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Total', total FROM s
